# Iteration 0156 shaped: independent review of matched-comparison-0155

## What I shaped and why
- Iteration 0155 (#706, benchmark) was accepted and merged at 27dc789b. It added `benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md` and `.json`, with rules M01-M16 and open items O01-O06. Source: `.session/history/sessions/706/61eff0a47e9ce1af472fefdefb55a037dd5fbee914dbc0ffe57b18b8d891b15b.md`.
- The last working memory says the next step after this design is an independent review with pinned inputs. So I ordered one task, `review-matched-comparison-0156`: role reviewer, default model, medium effort, 60 min, 40 turns. It exports the #706 and #703 reports.
- The check stays cold. The reviewer must save `.session/artifacts/expectations.md` from evaluation.md row `baseline`, the ledger and the 0138 file before opening the contract or the #706 report.
- The review must cover these points:
  - the SHA256 pins taken from the #706 report
  - that M01-M16 mean the same in the md and the json
  - the two stopping mappings #706 flagged as loose, checked against the ledger decision table
  - O06, checked directly against `project-run-binding-0138.json`
  - that O01-O06 are still open and no threshold is set
- The reviewer has no repository write paths. Its findings go in its report and its evidence in artifacts.
- The `## Verification` line only checks the repository: the json parses and the md is over 2000 bytes. I dropped a hash assertion I drafted first, because its pins came from a report summary and not from files I read.
- `.session/tasks.json` passed the direct Python JSON/heading check (exit 0) after the final edit. I ran no product, benchmark, evaluator or native code.
- I updated `journal/working-memory.md` with its four sections.

## What next
- The next shaper reads the 0156 record and the reviewer report.
- If the verdict is CLEAR, close the thread and pick the next named gap from the State list.
- If it is NOT-CLEAR, order one graph: a benchmark correction of the named findings, then a changed-scope reviewer task `blocked_by` that correction.
- Do not redraft matched-comparison-0155.
